caption: Officially, you have 'borrowed' 12 of my hoodies. Unofficially, I am down to wearing t-shirts in winter. You look better in them anyway, so I can't even complain.
We spent 4 hours assembling a single nightstand. We lost the Allen wrench twice, put the drawer slides on backwards, and had a mini-meltdown over a wooden peg. We survived, barely.

Me: 'Do you want some fries?'
You: 'No, I'm ordering a salad.'
Also you, 3 minutes after my burger arrives: *eats 80% of my golden crispy potato strips*.
You claimed you 'weren't even tired' and were going to watch the whole movie. Literally 6 minutes into the opening credits, you were snoring lightly on my collarbone.
A tiny spider appeared on the living room wall. You stood on top of the dining table wielding a rolled-up magazine, screaming like it was a wild dinosaur while I had to gently escort it outside.
